title: Monster
description:
A creature/enemy. A monster may carry one element (Wuxing five-phase), a tag the Wuxing module reads. Its attacks and innate abilities are drawn from the shared effect registry through schema.json#/definitions/appliedEffect, exactly like spells and consumables. Certain monsters with living spiritual or elemental essence can also drop spirit cores (see coreDrop); undead and humanoids must never have coreDrop.

Supports a Base + Override pattern: entries may either be flat monsters (all fields inline) or reference a base template and provide only overrides. Base templates live in bases/*.json and are resolved at validation/load time.

attack.description: A natural or carried weapon attack: the weapon's dice plus the attribute modifier of ability (docs/modules/monsters.md#attacks-resistances-and-role).

weapon.description: What the attack rolls: a natural weapon (core:natural_weapon/<key>), sized by the creature, or a carried weapon (core:weapon/<key>).

ability.description: The attribute whose modifier adds to the damage; default str.

type.description: The damage type, when it is not the weapon's. An element template does not change a type the attack names.

bonus.description: Added to the roll: what damagePerLevel gives a creature above its row's level.

delivery.description: Which reactions the attack allows (docs/core/combat.md); default single.

phase.description: The phase the attack carries into the five-phase cycles.

monsterData.description: Shared data shape used by both flat monster entries and overrides. All fields are optional here; requiredness is enforced at the entry level. Overrides may use the $extend merge convention on array fields (abilities, tags) to append to the base instead of replacing.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

phase.description: The monster's element, an optional tag the Wuxing module reads. A monster has at most one. Determines elemental affinity: incoming phased effects resolve against it through the generating/overcoming/weakening/insulting cycles in data/wuxing.

attributes.description: The eight attributes, keyed by ability id: at least 1 and no maximum, since 10 is only a player's cap at character creation. Optional; engines derive missing values from level.

hitPoints.description: Optional authored HP; it replaces the computed value (docs/core/actor-sheet.md).

skills.description: Only the skills this monster fights or casts with; any other reads as a starting value (docs/core/actor-sheet.md).

abilities.description: The monster's attacks and innate powers, drawn from the shared effect registry (data/effects). A monster typically wields effects of its own phase, but need not.

spells.description: Spells it casts as a player does, from the mana of the mp row (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates).

perks.description: Perks it holds, from the features table, each at a rank (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates, M3-15).

loot.description: The rows this monster rolls when defeated (docs/core/loot.md#drops). Replaces what it inherits.

role.description: Which hits-to-kill band of balance/core.json the HP is checked against; default standard.

attacks.description: What the monster hits with, as combat attacks (docs/modules/monsters.md#attacks-resistances-and-role).

resist.description: Flat resistance by damage type (a key in combat/damage_types.json), the combat pipeline's defender.resist.

growthDef.description: Optional level-scaling rules for base templates. Defines per-level attribute and HP growth. Only meaningful in base template files (bases/*.json); not used in core.json entries.

attributes.description: Per-level attribute growth rates. Keys are ability ids, values define growth per level beyond the template's base level.

perLevel.description: Increase per level beyond the template's base level.

hitPointsPerLevel.description: HP increase per level beyond the template's base level.

damagePerLevel.description: Added per level above a row's level, rounded, to each attack's damage and each damage_* ability's magnitude (docs/modules/monsters.md#attribute-growth--level-scaling).

coreDropShape.description: If present, this monster can drop a spirit core on death. **Hard rule**: undead and humanoids must never have this field. Only monsters with genuine living spiritual or elemental essence may include it.

monster.description: A fully self-contained monster entry with all required fields inline.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

attributes.description: The eight attributes, keyed by ability id: at least 1, no maximum.

hitPoints.description: Optional authored HP; it replaces the computed value (docs/core/actor-sheet.md).

skills.description: Only the skills this monster fights or casts with; any other reads as a starting value (docs/core/actor-sheet.md).

abilities.description: The monster's attacks and innate powers.

spells.description: Spells it casts as a player does, from the mana of the mp row (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates).

perks.description: Perks it holds, from the features table, each at a rank (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates, M3-15).

loot.description: The rows this monster rolls when defeated (docs/core/loot.md#drops). Replaces what it inherits.

role.description: Which hits-to-kill band of balance/core.json the HP is checked against; default standard.

attacks.description: What the monster hits with, as combat attacks (docs/modules/monsters.md#attacks-resistances-and-role).

resist.description: Flat resistance by damage type (a key in combat/damage_types.json), the combat pipeline's defender.resist.

monsterWithBase.description: A monster entry that references a base template and provides only overrides. The base is resolved at load time from bases/<base>.json and merged with overrides (override wins). This keeps core.json lean and enables easy variant creation.

base.description: The base: a creature type, or another monster in the same file (docs/core/composition.md).

templates.description: Keys in monsters/templates.json, at most one per slot, applied element, power, then nature, after the base and before overrides (docs/modules/monsters.md#templates).
